info.title: LLM API Pricing (static JSON API)
info.description: Read-only static JSON files generated from data/prices.json by scripts/build_api.py and served by GitHub Pages. All prices are USD per 1M tokens. Only GET is supported; there is no server-side filtering or query parameters, filter on the client. CORS: GitHub Pages sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * so files can be fetched from any origin. Dataset updated_at: 2026-10-25.

input.description: USD per 1M tokens; null when not listed or unverified (see pricing_status)

cached_input.description: USD per 1M tokens; null when not listed or unverified (see pricing_status)

peak_note.description: Peak / off-peak schedule or time-limited price note

source_url.description: Primary official source; see price_basis for full pricing and reference provenance

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning-effort / thinking-intensity support from official vendor docs. null = 待核实 (not verified, never guessed).

supported.description: true = the API exposes an adjustable reasoning effort / thinking switch or budget; false = no adjustable control (e.g. always-on thinking with no effort parameter); null = 待核实

levels.description: Accepted effort levels in ascending order (e.g. low, medium, high); null when not applicable or 待核实

default.description: Default level when the parameter is omitted; null when not stated / 待核实

can_disable.description: Whether reasoning can be turned off via the API; null = not stated in official docs

status.description: verified = all applicable facts documented; partial = some fields 待核实; unverified = support 待核实; see field_status

limits.description: Official context and output limits. null listed in unverified_fields = unknown; an explicitly absent output cap is also null, documented in note. Official K/M labels use 1K=1,000 / 1M=1,000,000 unless exact numbers are given.

context_length.description: Maximum context window in tokens (same value as top-level context_length)

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per request; null = unknown if listed in unverified_fields, otherwise no separate output cap documented (see note)

status.description: verified = both limits documented, including an explicitly absent output cap; partial = one; unverified = none

pricing_tiers.description: Long-context / prompt-length price tiers where documented, in addition to the base price in pricing (which is the lowest tier). Empty array = single tier (or tiers not documented). A request whose input falls in a tier is billed entirely at that tier's prices. A null price inside a tier = not documented for that tier.

input_tokens_gt.description: Tier applies when input tokens > this value

input.description: USD per 1M tokens; null when not listed or unverified (see pricing_status)

output.description: USD per 1M tokens; null when not listed or unverified (see pricing_status)

cached_input.description: Same meaning as pricing.cached_input, at this tier

cache_write.description: Same meaning as pricing.cache_write, at this tier

service_tiers.description: multiplier is an input/output display hint. Billing uses per-component multipliers, then explicit pricing overrides. Null multiplier means unknown, never zero. Storage has its own multiplier.

name.description: batch / flex / fast (OpenAI Fast = formerly Priority; Anthropic fast mode) / priority / ultrafast; data_residency = regional / US-only processing surcharge

multiplier.description: Price multiplier vs standard, e.g. 0.5 or 2

reference_multiplier.description: Documented multiplier of reference model base prices; omitted means 1. Tier prices are already expanded, not multiplied again.

CachePricing.description: Cache price breakdown where documented (USD per 1M tokens; null = not documented / 待核实). pricing.cached_input and pricing.cache_write keep their meaning; this object adds the finer split. Qwen: implicit_read / explicit_read / explicit_write are the three official cache prices.

explicit_write.description: Cache creation / write price at the default TTL (Anthropic 5 minutes, OpenAI 30 minutes)

explicit_write_1h.description: 1-hour TTL cache write price (Anthropic, Kimi K3)

explicit_write_12h.description: 12-hour minimum-TTL cache write price (OpenAI GPT-5.6+ Responses API prompt_cache_options.ttl="12h", 2.5x uncached input; the default 30-minute write is explicit_write / pricing.cache_write). Total write rate, not a surcharge. Long-context values are in pricing_tiers[].cache_pricing

storage_per_1M_tokens_hour.description: Cache storage fee per 1M tokens per hour (USD, not per 1M tokens; 0 = currently free)
